app.name: Busa PE Diligence
app.purpose: The desk's read-only diligence cockpit: an overview of what is in diligence and what needs attention (targets in diligence, open critical/high findings, overdue requests), a target list, one target's full picture (workstream progress, financial snapshot, top findings, next actions), and the findings wall sorted by severity.

binding.note: Shipped inside the Busa PE Diligence template package, so no Space, node or Base id exists at authoring time. At runtime the app resolves the resources the package installed via the SDK's inspectProvisionedResources, keyed by the folder slug, the per-Base slugs and the AirApp resourceKey declared in app/js/config.js. It never provisions, repairs or writes: a missing resource is reported as setup-required.

rules: Read-only: the app requests only nodes.list, nodes.get, records.list, records.get and records.count; it declares no setup or write procedures and no Change Request procedures.
Diligence conclusions are proposed by agents in chat and land through Change Requests — never from this cockpit.

Bounded reads: one page per Base per load at the configured readLimit (50); when a page has a next cursor the cockpit offers Load More for that Base, and headline counts come from records.count, not from the loaded page.
No credentials, no absolute Busabase URLs, no hostname-based runtime detection: the runtime is probed through the SDK helper against the relative __airapp/runtime path.

surfaces.reads: targets in stage = diligence with their diligence-requests progress per workstream; findings with status = open and severity in (critical, high); diligence-requests with status in (requested, blocked) and a due date in the past
surfaces.shows: three metrics (targets in diligence; open critical/high findings; overdue requests), per-target workstream progress bars, the overdue list, and the three most severe open findings
surfaces.title: Overview

surfaces.reads: targets, one page at the configured readLimit
surfaces.shows: every target with stage, deal type and target IC date; Load More while a next cursor exists
surfaces.title: Targets

surfaces.reads: one target joined to its diligence-requests, evidence, findings and interviews
surfaces.shows: financial snapshot, workstream progress, outstanding requests and the recorded next action, and the target's findings worst-first
surfaces.title: Target detail

surfaces.reads: findings, one page at the configured readLimit
surfaces.shows: every finding sorted by severity, with its claim, what the evidence shows, its impact on valuation or terms, and the evidence behind it
surfaces.title: Findings wall
